Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — it’s very simple to start with Nurosym. Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump in front of your ear canal).
Clip the earpiece onto your left tragus, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling sensation. 
Then just go about your day. You can read, work, meditate, or relax while using it. 
A good starting point is 15–60 minutes per session, and many people use it daily (for example in the morning or split between morning and evening).
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually increase as it feels comfortable. The sensation should always feel pleasant, not uncomfortable. 
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before getting started.
